title: WFA-0057 provenance-carry IR node
description: Subset of the vendor-neutral workflow IR sufficient to make source anchors and licence class non-droppable. Full WFA-0044 spec is not on this worktree. Every node kind requires a non-empty anchor and a non-empty licence_class; empty string is schema-invalid.

anchor.description: Source construct pointer. Empty string is invalid (same firmness as missing).

licence_class.description: Licence class travels with the anchor. Empty string is invalid.
